findings.title: Amortization denominator has no external anchor
findings.evidence: probe N validated only as integer in [0,2**63-1]; no binding of probe N to archive N_i; no binding of N_i to docs/v52/task4c2/V52_T4C2_feature_geometry.csv in any executable guard
findings.impact: effective_persistent_bytes_per_vector can be diluted without limit while both guards pass
findings.scope_note: CORRECTION_01: the headline aggregate mean_i(C_i/N_i) is unanchored too, via N_i alone, without any probe

findings.title: CORRUPT control can be made vacuous
findings.evidence: xor_mask bounded [1,255] (correct); byte_offset bounded [0,2**63-1] and not bounded against the corrupted artifact; probe with byte_offset=10**12 ACCEPTED
findings.impact: item-necessity proof (F2 BASELINE/REMOVE/RESTORE/CORRUPT) can pass with a no-op corruption

findings.title: Preflight raises KeyError instead of PreflightError on missing plan sub-fields
findings.evidence: plan fixture without sha256, plan copy without population_ids, population without count all CRASH(KeyError)
findings.impact: defense-in-depth only; parent guard rejects these first in the declared order
findings.severity_note: raised from LOW by CORRECTION_01: the parent-guard mitigation is unenforceable, see PLANPREP3-AUD-007

findings.title: Divergent MAX_ENTITIES between the two guards
findings.impact: latent drift; stricter guard gates first so no current hole

findings.title: Zero-byte physical artifact accepted without absence evidence
findings.impact: contract requires verifying absence of the persistent requirement before writing zero

findings.title: Non-regular file hangs preflight forever
findings.evidence: physical_locator -> FIFO; preflight never returns; timeout exit 124; reproduced by the lead session
findings.impact: fail-open by hang in the window the original report declared safe; a hang is not the promised stop

findings.title: No mechanical binding between the guarded plan and the preflighted plan
findings.evidence: preflight takes (plan_path, expected_plan_sha256, ...) with no Plan parameter and no contract_sha256 in the returned object
findings.impact: the declared execution order is unenforceable; a caller can guard plan A and preflight plan B

findings.title: Denominator rule yields a menu of candidate D_k, not a value
findings.evidence: one copy bound to four populations emits states spanning None, 1, 1000000000 and 4, ordered only by caller-supplied population_ids
findings.impact: selecting the largest candidate is exactly the dilution AUD-001 warns about; contract says D_k is THE real cardinality

findings.title: Uncaught OSError/ValueError from the companion binding documents
findings.evidence: relative_path '.' -> IsADirectoryError; embedded NUL -> ValueError; physical_locator '.' -> IsADirectoryError
findings.impact: the parent guard never sees these V3-owned schemas, so the AUD-003 mitigation does not extend here even in principle

findings.title: Version fields accept bool and float
findings.evidence: version True and 1.0 both ACCEPTED; version 2 correctly REJECTED
findings.impact: parent guard uses type(...) is int; preflight uses bare equality

findings.title: Two physical copies may bind to one file on disk
findings.evidence: pc1 and pc2 both bound to phys.bin ACCEPTED with copies=2
findings.impact: cannot distinguish two real copies from one file counted twice

report_errors_corrected: the absolute 'cannot be swapped' claim is false; frozen=True blocks rebinding only
